# /crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this

lane: cross-cutting | group: Keep the picture current | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.23.0 | prompts: 0
purpose: Answer one question about a feature, slice, resource, or not-yet-feature from the specs first.
use_when: One feature, slice, or resource
prompt_note: Prompt budget: 0 outside the walk. The walk's own prompts are the ones references/walk.md names (walk now, each item, more, a redraft confirm, and apply at the end). Follow-ups to understand what the user means do not count. Any other question counts.
reads: Reads one name, a sentence or two, an `@` path, or a focus, then the matching spec, plan, tasks, Match, open questions, and Research findings, plus `docs/system/`, `docs/architecture/spec.md`, and `docs/environments/marks.md`. Shows a stale research note as stale. After that, reads Azure resource settings and recent changes, and Azure DevOps work items, open pull requests, and branches. When the git remote is not Azure Repos and `docs/environments/marks.md` does not name the Azure DevOps org and project, derives them from Azure DevOps URLs in `docs/system/repos.md` and reads those work items, pull requests, and branches the same way, each tagged as a live read. Before reporting `az` as not installed, checks the default install paths on Windows, macOS, and Linux and uses that path when it is there.
writes: With no report word, writes nothing in the project. A `report-*` word other than `report-data-model-full` writes one Markdown report outside the project (Downloads, else a temp folder) and the chat links it. The first playbook write stays there. Apply copies a filled playbook to `docs/playbooks/`. A draft with no filled answer is not copied. `report-data-model-full` writes one new immutable `report.md` and `report.pdf` under `docs/data-model/<model>/reviews/` and does not edit the saved model.
leaves alone: Leaves the saved model, specs, code, marks, commits, and pull requests alone during the answer and the walk. The data-model review does not edit the model. Apply, which this skill may start at the end of a playbook walk, writes the spec answers and the `docs/playbooks/` copy.
limits: pasted minutes or a long dump stops and names `/crav1-add-to-spec`. Two or more close hits ask which. A live-read failure offers Retry or Skip. It does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. It is not a starter option. A playbook walk does not speak item ids. Apply writes only filled confirmed lines, copies a filled playbook to docs/playbooks, and does not run plan, build, or merge. It does not git-commit. It does not start /crav1-help or /crav1-pr-status.
flow:
- no matching slice, and a `report-` word, each open one references file.
- the apply offer at the end of a walk is one card.
- `yes (Recommended)` runs apply.
- Typed changes go on that card's free-text answer.
- that end card prints a findings table in the same reply before the card.
- The card names each item and its recommendation.
- It does not say `table above`.
- The card is not asked without the table.
- A word `report-<type>-<depth>` picks a fixed Markdown report: `report-feature-short`, `report-feature-full`, `report-change-short`, `report-change-full`, `report-build-short`, `report-build-full`, and (1.109.0, preview) `report-playbook-short`, `report-playbook-full`, and `report-playbook-walk`, which resumes a guided walk in chat through an existing playbook report (`report-playbook-full` asks to walk after writing; answers are saved into the report as they come; headless runs never walk).
- `report-data-model-full` reads one saved model and writes an immutable Markdown review and a PDF with rendered diagrams; it does not model again.
- It routes first and loads only `reports/common.md` and that one `reports/<type>-<depth>.md`; no report word stays the free-form answer and opens no report file.
- Mermaid wherever a picture helps, only the diagrams that file lists; C4 always in feature-full, in change-full only when the change alters architecture or pipelines.
- Playbook reports sort decisions into Kept, Needs your answer (a recommended answer and why; undecided or decided by a named person, never a hand-off) and Compose, then list the kit skills in order (short at most 8 steps) with a dependency-order diagram; answers stay in the report until the user confirms.
- During a walk the chat states each item in words and does not use item ids; `go to N9` still jumps.
- It does not start `/crav1-help` or `/crav1-pr-status`.
- A live source that needs a sign-in, a permission, or a missing tool is asked about first (Allow or Skip); facts are tagged `Live read.`, guesses `(inference, not in the docs)`.
- Feature, change, and build reports are written outside the project, to Downloads when reachable, else a temp folder, and the chat always links or attaches them.
- On apply, a filled playbook is copied to `docs/playbooks/`.
- `report-data-model-full` is the exception: one new immutable `report.md` and `report.pdf` under `docs/data-model/<model>/reviews/`, and it does not edit the saved model.
- A gap in the answer (unknown or inferred) that matches an open question in a spec ends with one line naming `/crav1-show-or-ask-open-questions ask research <a few words from that question>`, with the spec only when the words match more than one spec.
- Each matching question gets its own line, never one line for several.
- When the user asks about one feature, slice, resource, or not-yet-feature, **`/crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this`** answers from the specs first.
- An `@` keeps the search inside that path.
- No slice: it says so, shows what the repo, the code, and the environment notes know, and presents a candidate slice.
- It names `/crav1-spark-to-spec`, `/crav1-ideas-to-spec`, or `/crav1-bundle-to-specs` and does not run them.
- Pasted minutes or a long dump names `/crav1-add-to-spec` and stops.
- After the repo part it runs read-only live checks: Azure resource settings and recent changes, and Azure DevOps work items, open pull requests, and branches.
- Production is shape and connections only, after the same yes or no as `/crav1-read-environment`.
- It never reads data.
- Apply copies a filled playbook to `docs/playbooks/`.
- `report-data-model-full` writes one immutable snapshot under `docs/data-model/<model>/reviews/` and does not edit the model.
- It does not start `/crav1-help` or `/crav1-pr-status`.
- It is not `/crav1-explain-existing-system`.
- Apply copies a filled playbook to `docs/playbooks/`.
- `report-data-model-full` writes one immutable snapshot under `docs/data-model/<model>/reviews/` and does not edit the model.
- Production is shape and connections only, after the same yes or no as `/crav1-read-environment`.
- Never data.
- Not `/crav1-explain-existing-system`.

runs by itself: Starts no skill except apply on /crav1-resolve-open-questions at the end of a playbook walk, on yes, for filled confirmed lines.
